evidence.detail: Client exposes an interface-draw wrapper with signature (int,int,rs/n/e,int) that delegates directly and exclusively to rs/l/b/d.a(Client,int,int,rs/n/e,int).

The renderer resolves child widgets from the rs/n/e interface table, applies parent offsets/scroll state and recursively invokes its own interface-render method for nested interface/container children.
During traversal it invokes the already-reviewed InterfaceDrawCallback on widgets that own one, passing the resolved screen x/y coordinates before continuing the concrete widget render path.

The same path performs clipping and renders live interface content including text, sprites, item/inventory/model surfaces, hover/selection state and exact widget-scoped presentation strings such as 'Click here to continue' and 'Please wait...'.

proposals.note: Descriptive semantic recovery from exact-v308 central rs/n/e widget rendering behavior; original stripped source identifier is not claimed.
